chunks.text: NACA Field Manual for Aquatic Animal Disease Diagnosis in South Asian Tropical Aquaculture Systems. This document provides official regulatory, scientific, and field protocols tailored for aquaculture practitioners and researchers in Tamil Nadu.
Maintain dissolved oxygen above 4.0 mg/L, pH between 7.5 and 8.5, and zero free ammonia. Implement bird netting, crab fencing, and reservoir disinfection with 30 ppm active chlorine before stocking.
